editorial:
You and your friends rent a creepy old house for the weekend, and one of you finds a dusty deck of tarot cards. Instead of leaving them alone, you decide to do readings for fun. Big mistake. The cards are cursed, and each reading pulls a dark fate into your life. Soon, the friends start dying in ways that match the cards they drew. The movie follows a group of young adults who must figure out how to break the curse before the deck claims everyone. It has a spooky, fun vibe that feels like a classic slasher mixed with supernatural horror.

The acting is solid for a horror flick, and the creature designs are pretty cool. The pacing moves fast, so you never get bored. On the downside, some characters feel thin, and a few scares are predictable. Still, if you like fun, spooky movies with friends, this is a good pick. It is best enjoyed with the lights off and friends around.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the last survivors learn the only way to stop the curse is to destroy the original deck. They track it down and burn it, but the evil does not fully die. One friend who seemed safe reveals she drew the Death card and is now possessed. She kills the others and walks away with the cards, hinting the curse will continue. The twist is that destroying the deck only delays the evil, not ends it.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fun supernatural horror with friends.
